correctness.rationale: The explicit K={|xi|+|xj|<=2} has six axial and eight diagonal vertices, 12 rhombus facets and 24 edges of length sqrt(3). For a generic affine plane the section-side count equals the number of edge-height crossings. Ordered normal chamber a>b>c>0 decomposes into three zones and seven rational subchambers, with pairwise vertex-height signs fixed on each rational triangle. Sweeping the 13 successive height intervals yields the recorded exact zone coefficient table L_k(u)=r*a+s*b+v*c for k=3,...,9; all cases and the boundaries are accounted for up to measure zero. The spherical first-moment formula for geodesic triangles integrates each coefficient to J_k (closed arctangent expressions), normalized by Z=pi*sqrt(3)/6 from the edge/dihedral mean-width identity. The edge crossing integral independently gives EN=6 and the seven masses sum to Z. The independently reconstructed 14 vertices/24 edges, three sector witnesses and seven probabilities agree to roundoff; numerical integration and sampling are supplemental to rational chamber coverage and analytic spherical integration.
residual_risks: The result is for motion-invariant affine plane measure conditioned on intersection, with normal direction weighted by width; not for central Haar sections or unweighted uniform normals.
Exact moment constants rely on elementary inverse-trigonometric angle identities independently checked numerically; source supplies the analytic expressions.
